title: REQ · One palette file defines at most 48 colours in warm and cool ramps and exports constants
summary: Single palette module with named ramps and exported constants
description: Context: no palette exists in game/frontend/src. Desired behavior: game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts defines 8 ramps of 6 hex colours (4 warm: wood, brass, parchment, lamp; 4 cool: indigo, plum, moon, hoodie), exported as PALETTE_RAMPS, a flat PALETTE array and WARM_RAMPS / COOL_RAMPS name lists. Expected result: any module imports the same colours. Why: art and UI must share one palette.
acceptance_criteria: Given PALETTE, when its length is read, then it is at most 48 and every entry matches /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/.
Given PALETTE, when deduplicated, then no colour repeats.
Given WARM_RAMPS and COOL_RAMPS, when read, then each name exists in PALETTE_RAMPS and the two lists do not overlap.

out_of_scope: Using the palette in art code

technical_constraints: One shared palette of at most 48 colours, defined once and used by art and UI.
definition_of_done: palette.ts exists and exports the constants
